instruction: Customer: Can I return a jacket I have not worn? I still have the order number.
response: Yes. Northline accepts returns within 30 days of delivery when the item is unworn and you provide the order number. The refund goes back to the original payment method.

instruction: Customer: The box showed up crushed and the jacket is torn. What do I send you?
response: Send a photo of the damage and the order number. Northline will ship a replacement or issue a refund, and we waive the return shipping fee.

instruction: Customer: How long does standard shipping take, and is expedited faster?
response: Standard Northline shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Expedited shipping takes 2 business days, starting the day after the order leaves the warehouse.

instruction: Customer: Where is the tracking link for my package?
response: Northline sends the tracking link in the shipment email. It also appears on the account orders page once the carrier scans the package.

instruction: Customer: The order still says Processing. Can I cancel it?
response: Yes. A Northline order can be canceled while the status is Processing. After it changes to Shipped, use the return process instead.

instruction: Customer: I put the wrong address on the order and it has not shipped.
response: Northline can change the shipping address before the warehouse marks the order Shipped. After that, contact the carrier with the tracking number.

instruction: Customer: My card shows a pending charge that says NORTHLINE*OUTFITTERS.
response: That is the Northline statement name. The pending hold drops off after the order ships, and then the final charge posts.

instruction: Customer: I mailed the return back. When does the refund show up?
response: After the warehouse receives the Northline return, the refund posts to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.

instruction: Customer: The seam on my pack split. Is that covered?
response: Northline packs have a lifetime warranty on seams. Send the order number and a short description of the failure and we will open a warranty claim.

instruction: Customer: My headlamp stopped charging after a few months.
response: Headlamps and other Northline electronics have a 1-year warranty. A claim needs the order number and a short description of the failure.

instruction: Customer: I did not get the password reset email link. How long is it good for?
response: Northline password reset links are sent from the sign-in page and expire after 30 minutes. A new request invalidates the previous link.

instruction: Customer: What time do the stores close, and are you open on Thanksgiving?
response: Northline stores are open from 10am to 7pm local time. Stores are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

instruction: Customer: Does a gift card expire if I do not use it this year?
response: Northline gift cards do not expire. They cannot be redeemed for cash, and they cannot be used to buy another gift card.

instruction: Customer: The boots are the wrong size. Can I exchange them?
response: Northline offers one free size exchange per item within 30 days of delivery. The replacement ships after the original size is scanned back at the warehouse.

instruction: Customer: Can you ship this tent to a friend in Canada?
response: Yes. Northline ships online orders to addresses in the United States and Canada. We do not ship to other international addresses.

instruction: Customer: I live in the UK. Can you ship the tent here?
response: No. Northline ships only to the United States and Canada, so we cannot send an order to a UK address.

instruction: Customer: Can I stack a promo code on a jacket that is already on sale?
response: No. A Northline order accepts one promo code, and promo codes cannot be combined with items already marked as a sale price.

instruction: Customer: How do I wash the down jacket without ruining the fill?
response: Wash a Northline down jacket cold on the gentle cycle, then tumble dry on low heat with clean tennis balls so the down refluffs.

instruction: Customer: The leather boots got soaked. Can I dry them on the radiator?
response: No. Dry Northline leather boots at room temperature, not on a radiator, and condition the leather twice a season.

instruction: Customer: I am a Trail member. Do I still pay for shipping on a $60 order?
response: Northline Trail members get free standard shipping on orders over $50. Expedited shipping is still charged.

instruction: Customer: How do I delete my account, and do you sell my data?
response: You can delete a Northline account in settings. We use account data to fulfill orders and answer support requests, and we do not sell personal information.

instruction: Customer: I want to stock your packs in my shop. Who do I talk to?
response: Northline wholesale requests, including retailer accounts and bulk pricing, go to wholesale@northline.example.

instruction: Customer: The jacket arrived with a broken zipper and I want a new one, not a refund.
response: Send a photo of the damage and the order number. Northline can ship a replacement, and we waive the return shipping fee.

instruction: Customer: It has been 20 days since delivery and the fleece is unworn. Can I still return it?
response: Yes. Northline accepts unworn returns within 30 days of delivery when you provide the order number, and the refund returns to the original payment method.

instruction: Customer: The status just changed to Shipped. Can you still cancel and stop the truck?
response: No. Once a Northline order is Shipped it cannot be canceled. Use the return process after you receive it.

instruction: Customer: I requested two password resets. Which link should I use?
response: Use the newest Northline link. Each new password reset invalidates the previous one, and a link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.

instruction: Customer: Can I use the gift card balance to buy another gift card?
response: No. Northline gift cards cannot be used to buy another gift card, and they cannot be redeemed for cash. They do not expire.

instruction: Customer: My Trail membership order is $40 and I want expedited shipping. Is shipping free?
response: Free standard shipping for Northline Trail members starts on orders over $50. A $40 order does not qualify, and expedited shipping is charged even when standard shipping is free.
